guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile fails during the installation of the litellm dependency with the error: 'fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address' when running 'python3.11 -m pip install "git+https://github.com/StanGirard/litellm.git@main#egg=litellm"'. This indicates that the build environment cannot access the repository due to authentication or network restrictions. It may be caused by Git configuration or missing git credentials in the container environment, or GitHub possibly requiring authentication for this repo clone even though it is public. Recommended fixes include:
- Check if the network environment used by Docker has restrictions on git cloning from GitHub.
- Consider using HTTPS with token authentication if private repo access is needed.
- Try switching from HTTPS to SSH clone URLs with appropriate keys, if feasible.
- Alternatively, pre-clone the dependency outside of the Docker build and copy it into the image.
- Another way is to modify the Dockerfile to clone the litellm repo manually before pip install or vendor the dependency.
- Verify git configuration in the image; installing 'git' is done already.
This is a definitive build failure and must be fixed in the Dockerfile before proceeding to test execution.
